body.subject: Issue #320 closed: the embedded host serves a real wake child, a delivered guide writes the wake row its class reads, and the pinned row leaves the manifest

items.change: scripts/baton.mjs no longer prints the returned ended row when a printed frame already named the end: a wake follow that ends on the pinned swarm's closed wake printed that frame as its last page, and reprinting the row put a pretty multi-line document on stdout whose contract is one JSON frame per line
items.evidence: before: the row's JSON.parse on stdout threw uncaughtException (Expected property name or '}' at position 1); after: the child prints 6 baton.wake frames and exits 0

items.change: src/swarm-runtime.mjs _recordGuidanceSent writes the message lane's message.delivered row (swarmId, participantId, messageId, kind) when the lane took the guide — the row docs/39 names as the one that wakes guidance_delivered, and the row the recruit-time composition already writes for the parked guidance it delivers; a refused delivery writes none
items.test: node scripts/run-suite.mjs test/issue273-guidance-runtime.test.mjs test/swarm-runtime.test.mjs test/issue543-resume-ask-delivery.test.mjs test/issue311-swarm-notify.test.mjs test/issue525-resume-decision.test.mjs
items.evidence: GREEN — 5 files, 0 unexpected, 0 stale; a live guide's ledger now carries the row with the swarm coordinates the frame resolves from

items.change: src/wake-stream.mjs wakeClassFor consults the bare row-kind key last, the third key the class index documents; the message lane's payload kind names the delivery mode ('nudge'/'steer'), not an operational event, so the lookup returned null before reaching the key guidance_delivered is registered under
items.test: node scripts/run-suite.mjs test/wake-stream.test.mjs test/issue316-sse-attachment-closed.test.mjs test/issue356-wake-frame.test.mjs test/wake-binding.test.mjs test/wake-mcp-consumers.test.mjs test/issue507-wakes-since-cli.test.mjs
items.evidence: GREEN — 6 files, 0 unexpected, 0 stale; the parked delivery's documented wake classifies through the same key now

items.change: the #320 expected-red row (test/swarm-wake.test.mjs :: a real resident wakes a real baton swarm watch --follow child on guidance, contribution, and close) is removed from impl/scripts/expected-red-tests.json; the file stays byte-identical to the canonical writer's output, checked through manifestRows
items.evidence: SUBSET 1 of 726 files: GREEN — 9 passed, 0 expected red, 0 unexpected, 0 stale, 0 hung

carriedForward: The canonical full-suite command (npm test --prefix impl) is not run by this seat: this tree carries another lane's red closure, measured here over the 7-file MCP/surface set — 39 passed, 27 unexpected, 0 stale (issue314-core-table, issue314-lane2-receipts-wakes, issue314-mcp-core-surface-red, mcp-bridge-admission, surface-capability-catalog, unified-mcp-surface, issue462-handoff-env-scoped), the count wake-lead3 reported on master 65c913f0.

The 14-file run over the wake/bridge/guidance/CLI set this fix touches: GREEN — 120 passed, 0 expected red, 0 unexpected, 0 stale, 0 hung (run twice, before and after the commit). A 12-file serve-path/CLI pass: GREEN — 83 passed, 0 unexpected, 0 stale.

The issue's attach symptom does not reproduce on this tree: a genuinely separate child attaches over the owner socket (web.audit wake_stream_connected at the attach) and receives every frame, exit 0. [INFERENCE] the issue's Error: aborted signature matches the pre-#445 owner-socket transport bound that 1a830bfe replaced; that commit lands after the #320 pin and gives the transport a bound of its own derived from the wait ceiling.

test/issue276-resident-drain.test.mjs RD3 failed once beside two other files on this loaded host (serve child exit 1: application_host_lease_unavailable) and passes alone (4/4 GREEN); the file is outside this fix's paths.
needsFromOthers: mcp-lead3: the core-table/alias fix on master — the canonical full-suite command cannot pass in this deployment until the MCP/surface closure is green (the same need wake-lead3 carries).
